root_causes: Option selector used descendant button:nth-of-type(1), which resolved to all nine DDS option buttons and failed Playwright strict mode.
The driver sent Delete/Backspace while the multi-select search input was empty; DDS interprets this as remove the last selected chip.
Selected-set extraction omitted aria-checked=true, while this DDS component exposes selection through aria-checked/data-selected and selected icons.
patched_behavior: Unique option selector uses listbox id plus aria-posinset.
No destructive key is sent when the search input is empty.
Each option is added while preserving all previously selected values.
Final verification reopens the listbox and compares the exact selected option set.
aria-checked, data-selected, aria-selected, and selected-icon state are recognized.
